description: Security policy of the todo app team (version 1). Rules for input handling, destructive operations, rendering user text and dependencies. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or code that reads files or input, deletes or overwrites data, renders user text, or adds a dependency.
version: 1
owner: Khoa (tech lead, also security owner, simulated) · backup: Mai (simulated)

# Security policy · v1

Sample policy for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-security@1#S<n>`.

- **S1.** Treat every imported file as untrusted. Validate it against the expected schema, reject unknown fields, cap its size at
  1 MB, never evaluate its content.
- **S2.** Any operation that overwrites or deletes more than one item asks for an explicit confirmation **before** it runs, and the
  confirmation says what will be lost (for example "Thay 12 việc hiện có bằng 30 việc trong file?").
- **S3.** Render user-provided text with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- **S4.** No new external dependency (CDN script, library, web service) without sign-off from the security owner.

- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

56	### Thiết kế
57	- **`store`** (giữ khoá `todo.v1` và dạng mảng việc; không thêm khoá, không thêm trường, A12):
58	  - `load()` → `{ todos, readError }`. Không có khoá (`getItem` trả `null`) → `{ todos: [], readError: false }`. Có dữ liệu nhưng
59	    `JSON.parse` lỗi, parse ra không phải mảng (kể cả `"null"`, Q5), hoặc `getItem` ném lỗi → `{ todos: [], readError: true }`.
60	    Không kiểm từng việc trong mảng (A13 chỉ có ba trường hợp).
61	  - `store.readError` là **nguồn duy nhất** của trạng thái đọc lỗi, chỉ trong bộ nhớ trang (A12); `app.js` không giữ bản sao.
62	  - `save(todos)` → `'saved' | 'failed' | 'skipped'`. Khi `readError`: **không gọi `setItem`**, trả `'skipped'` (F5 bước 5, A14).
63	    `setItem` ném lỗi → `'failed'` (không `console.error` nữa).
64	  - `replace(todos)` → `'saved' | 'failed'`: đường duy nhất được ghi khi đọc lỗi (F5 bước 6, A15); chỉ xoá `readError` khi ghi thành
65	    công (A17).
66	- **`backup.js`** (không có chữ "localStorage" kể cả trong comment, vì `static.test.js` cấm):
67	  - `MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 1048576` (Q3).
68	  - `toBackupText(todos)` → `JSON.stringify({ version: 1, todos: [{ id, title, done, createdAt }] }, null, 2)`; chỉ chép bốn trường
69	    (P2, P3).
70	  - `backupFileName(date)` → `todo-sao-luu-YYYY-MM-DD.json` theo **giờ máy** (A11).
71	  - `tooBigToImport(text)` → `new TextEncoder().encode(text).length > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES` (F1 bước 5).
72	  - `parseBackup(text)` → `{ ok: true, todos }` hoặc `{ ok: false, message }`, chỉ dùng `JSON.parse`, không bao giờ eval (S1):
73	    - không parse được, hoặc gốc không phải object (ảnh, văn bản bất kỳ, `null`, mảng) → M9;
74	    - khoá gốc khác đúng `version` + `todos`, `version !== 1`, `todos` không phải mảng → M9;
75	    - `todos` rỗng → M8 (Q4);
76	    - một việc có khoá khác đúng bốn khoá, `id` không phải chuỗi hoặc rỗng, `title` không phải chuỗi hoặc rỗng sau `trim`, `done`
77	      không phải boolean, `createdAt` không phải số hữu hạn, hoặc hai việc trùng `id` → M10, từ chối **cả file** (A7).
78	  - `confirmText({ readError, current, incoming })` → `null` khi không đọc lỗi và `current === 0` (F2 bước 6); ngược lại M5, M6
79	    hoặc M7.
80	  - `persist(store, todos)` → `{ message }`: `'saved'` → `null` (xoá thông báo F3 cũ); `'failed'` → M3; `'skipped'` → `null` (dải
81	    báo F5 đã hiện, không bật gì thêm, A14).

83	    `{ todos, message }`. Thứ tự:
84	    1. `file.size > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES` → M11, **không gọi `file.text()`**;
85	    2. `await file.text()`; ném lỗi (file không đọc được, bị thu hồi quyền) → M14 (Khoa #3);

87	    4. `confirmText` khác `null` → `await ask(câu)`; `false` → không có thông báo;
88	    5. **`store.replace(incoming)`** (không bao giờ `save`) → `'saved'`: trả `incoming` + M4b; `'failed'`: trả `current` + M17

90	
91	    Mọi nhánh trừ bước 5 `'saved'` trả **`current`**; các nhánh 1–4 không gọi `replace`.
92	- **`app.js`**:
93	  - Khởi động: `todos = store.load().todos`; `render()`.
94	  - `render()`: dải báo F5 (M16) hiện khi `store.readError`; dòng trống (M13) hiện khi `todos.length === 0 && !store.readError`

96	    đề vẫn qua `textContent` (S3). Thêm, đánh dấu, xoá giữ nguyên.
97	  - `commit()`: `message = persist(store, todos).message`, hiện ở vùng thông báo, rồi `render()`.

# Plan: "Xoá việc đã xong" button (clear completed)

Status: draft · Size: **Medium** (small feature, 4 app files + 3 test files) · Date: 2026-10-29
After approval this is saved as `plan/2026-10-29-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` (Vietnamese, same structure as
`plan/2026-10-19-khach-khong-mat-viec.md`), `Status: draft`. A person accepts it; no code before that.

## Context
Customers can only delete finished tasks one by one (× per row, `app/app.js:19`). The app already tells them to
"xoá bớt việc đã xong" when storage is full (M3, M17 in `app/backup.js:8-12`), so a one-click way to do that is the
natural follow-up. Outcome: one button removes every `done` task, after a confirmation that says how many will go.

**Process gap (for the person reading this):** there is no intent or spec for this change. The team flow is
intent → spec → plan. Either a person accepts this plan directly (feature is small), or I run `/write-intent` first.

## Policies that apply
- `policy-security@1#S2`: deletes more than one item → confirm **before**, saying what is lost: "Xoá {n} việc đã xong?".
- `policy-ux@2#U2`: single-item action → no dialog. So with exactly **1** done task the button deletes at once (like ×).
  No Undo, same open gap as × (C4 of the backup spec) — see Q2.
- `#U3`: button hidden when there is nothing done. `#U4`: Vietnamese, no tech words. `#U5`: real `<button>`, keyboard + label.
- `#S3`: no user text rendered (only counts). `#S4`: no dependency.

## Decisions to confirm (open)
| Q | Question | Proposal | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | Accept a plan without intent/spec? | Yes, Medium, no data-format change | Thảo (PO) / Khoa |
| Q2 | 1 done task: delete at once (U2) or still confirm? | At once, per U2 literal | Linh (UX) |
| Q3 | Wording (proposals) | Button "Xoá việc đã xong"; ask "Xoá {n} việc đã xong?"; dialog yes "Xoá"; done "Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong." | Linh |
| Q4 | Which tasks with a filter on? | All done tasks, whatever filter is shown | Thảo |

## Files that change
| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/backup.js` | `MESSAGES.confirmClearDone`, `MESSAGES.clearedDone`; new DOM-free `clearDone({ store, current, ask })`; export it |
| `app/app.js` | `ask(question, yes = 'Thay')` sets the yes-button text; `#clear-done` handler; `render()` hides button when no done task |
| `app/index.html` | `<button type="button" id="clear-done">Xoá việc đã xong</button>` next to `#count`; `id="confirm-yes"` on the dialog yes button |
| `app/style.css` | Only if the button needs spacing next to the count line |
| `tests/backup.test.js` · `tests/app.test.js` · `tests/static.test.js` | New tests (Proof) |
| `plan/2026-10-29-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` | Progress line, written by the person who commits |

### Design
- **`clearDone({ store, current, ask })`** in `backup.js` (decisions live there; `app.js` only wires DOM, CLAUDE.md):
  1. `done = current().filter(t => t.done)`; none → `{ todos: current(), message: null }`, `ask` not called.
  2. `done.length >= 2` → `await ask(fill(MESSAGES.confirmClearDone, { n }))`; false → unchanged list, no message.
  3. Remove **exactly the ids counted in step 1** from `current()` (re-read after the dialog — an import that finished
     meanwhile must not lose tasks nobody was asked about; same lesson as the overlapping-import fix, R7).
  4. `persist(store, todos)` (reuse, `backup.js:115`): `'failed'` → M3; else `fill(MESSAGES.clearedDone, { n })`.
     Uses `store.save`, never `replace`, so a read-error list is never overwritten (`'skipped'`, banner already shown).
- **`app.js`**: `$('#clear-done').onclick = async () => { const r = await clearDone({ store, current: () => todos, ask: (q) => ask(q, 'Xoá') }); todos = r.todos; show(r.message); render(); }`.
  `ask` writes `yes` into `#confirm-yes.textContent`; import keeps "Thay" via the default.
  `render()`: `$('#clear-done').hidden = !todos.some(t => t.done)`.

## Order of work
1. Tests in `backup.test.js` for `clearDone` + messages → run, see them fail (function missing).
2. `backup.js`: messages + `clearDone`. `node --test` green for those.
3. `index.html` (button, `#confirm-yes`) + `static.test.js`.
4. `app.js` wiring + `app.test.js` (extend `loadApp` so the fake dialog can answer "yes" and records the yes label).
5. `bash scripts/check.sh` → OK; run `verifier` subagent against the plan; manual check below.

## Risks
- **Import still says "Thay"**: the shared dialog label is now set per call. Test pins both labels.
- **List changes while the dialog is open** (import finishing): handled by id snapshot (step 3); tested.
- **Deleting what the customer did not see**: with filter "Chưa xong", done tasks are off-screen; the count in the
  question is the only signal. Q4.
- **No Undo**: deleted tasks are gone unless backed up. Same as × today; Undo is its own intent (C4).
- `tests/app.test.js` fake DOM: `querySelectorAll` returns `[]`; `hidden` on a fake element is just a field — fine.

## Proof
| Step | Test |
|---|---|
| 0 done → no ask, no save | `backup.test.js` |
| 1 done → no ask, removed, saved, "Đã xoá 1 việc đã xong." | `backup.test.js` (U2) |
| 3 done of 5 → ask text exactly "Xoá 3 việc đã xong?"; cancel → list same, `save` 0 times; yes → 2 open left | `backup.test.js` (S2) |
| 2.001 done → "Xoá 2.001 việc đã xong?" (formatCount) | `backup.test.js` |
| list grows during ask (extra done task added) → only the asked ids are removed | `backup.test.js` |
| `save` → `'failed'` → M3; `'skipped'` → no write via `replace` | `backup.test.js` |
| New messages free of "localStorage", "JSON", "console" (existing scan covers `MESSAGES`) | `backup.test.js` |
| Button exists with label, `type="button"`; dialog yes button has `id="confirm-yes"` | `static.test.js` |
| Click in app: dialog label "Xoá"; import dialog still "Thay"; button hidden with no done task | `app.test.js` |

Run: `bash scripts/check.sh` → must end with `== check: OK` (test count grows from 44).
Manual (desktop browser, `python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`): 3 done → confirm → gone, reload still gone; Esc cancels;
Tab/Enter/Space reach and press the button; button hidden when nothing done; read-error state (`todo.v1` = `{hỏng`)
→ clearing does not write `todo.v1`.
